The '''transport skiff''' was a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] [[Skiff/Legends|skiff]] developed by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] and used around the time of the [[war against Zakuul]].
